tests.attack: Count formula appearances of π as independent empirical evidence.
tests.criterion: Independent evidence count is dependency-quotient count, not raw π token frequency.

tests.attack: Count circumference/diameter, area/diameter, cylinder volume, PI-tape diameter and flow diameter formulas as separate π evidence.
tests.criterion: They share Q01/D01 classical geometric origin; empirical residuals are preserved but π-origin is counted once.

tests.attack: Treat 2π radians per cycle as a measured physical constant.
tests.criterion: KENG-02 is stated in return-to-reference/time/cycle-fraction language; radian appears only in forbidden effective imports.

tests.attack: Promote 2π or transform scaling from one Fourier convention into native input.
tests.criterion: Q03 is excluded from π-specific K_eng; FFTW/NumPy/DLMF convention dependence is explicit.

tests.attack: Promote Gaussian/heat-kernel integral normalization into native constant.
tests.criterion: KENG-03 retains relaxation/spread and strips Gaussian amplitude normalization.

tests.attack: Insert circle, center, radius, distance/equidistance or effective PDE geometry into native premises.
tests.criterion: Every native interface entry has allowed_native_inputs=UNSPECIFIED and explicit forbidden imported definitions.

tests.attack: Accept a future candidate solely because one readout numerically approaches the classical decimal expansion of π.
tests.criterion: Kernel pass requires all four operational members, scales/tolerances and no leakage; one scalar has zero standalone pass authority.
